tasks.modified_instruction: Nest all three bowls upright, release them, then return to origin.

tasks.original_instruction: Plug the charger into the power strip.
tasks.modified_instruction: Insert the charger fully upright into the power-strip socket, release it, then return to origin.

tasks.original_instruction: Hold the pen holder with one hand, place all pens into it with the other hand, then put it back down.
tasks.modified_instruction: Hold the pen holder upright, insert all four pens tip-up one by one, place it down, then return to origin.
